products.name: Slice Case
products.summary: A magnetic backplate with a ribbed surface. Official Duo product photographs show the front and side controls left exposed.
products.releaseNote: Official listing found. Exact dispatch date and orderability are unconfirmed.
products.shippingNote: EUR listing served with Italy selected. UK price and delivered total have not been verified.
limitations: The page displays both Add to cart and Notify when available. Confirm orderability before purchase.
The description still names iPhone 17 Pro despite the Duo-specific title, collection and photographs. The generic 1 mm specification is excluded from Duo measurement sorting.
Backplate only. It does not provide a front frame or full edge coverage.
No independent Duo-specific performance test was established.

sources.title: NUDIENT Slice Case MagSafe: iPhone Duo

Product specifications state polycarbonate; legacy model wording and unclear availability are flagged.
